svg.aria-label: Block server processing. A new file is split into blocks of at most 4 MB, each block is compressed (for example with gzip or bzip2) and encrypted, then uploaded to cloud storage. When a file is edited, delta sync compares block hashes: here only blocks 3 and 6 have new hashes, so only those 2 of the 8 blocks are uploaded.
svg.title: Block servers and delta sync
